## Summary

Describe the problem and the resulting behavior.

## Validation

- [ ] Relevant React tests pass, or the PR explains why they are not applicable.
- [ ] Relevant Vue tests pass, or the PR explains why they are not applicable.
- [ ] Type checks, builds, and registry checks affected by this change pass.
- [ ] User-facing interaction or layout changes were exercised in both runnable examples with a real browser.

## React/Vue parity and documentation

- [ ] Consumer-facing behavior is implemented equivalently in React and Vue, or this PR explains why the change has no framework impact.
- [ ] Public names, defaults, aliases, serialized state, and shared fixtures remain aligned.
- [ ] `docs/FRAMEWORK-PARITY.md` and the Vue example reflect the final behavior when affected.
- [ ] A linked `Yayaw-SAS/Yayaw` PR updates the English and French documentation plus its protected seed transition, or this PR explains why public documentation is unaffected.
